payload.question: Landing in main is stuck behind plumb's merge check, even for plumb-65's small fix. Three things hold it. First, 22 tests marked 'passed before, now fails', most of them on approve/confirm commands that INT-114 retires, so they're probably recorded from INT-114's test run in another worktree rather than real failures in main. Second, a proof you haven't seen working yet. Third, one link whose tests ran out of time. Everything is parked safely: the fix on land/report-fix, INT-114 on land/int114 (full suite green), the benchmark fixes on land/eval-fixes. Main is untouched. How should I go on?
